paragraphs: Priority Dispatch sells ProQA, software for the Emergency Dispatch process, and the protocols that software runs on. Those protocols come from the International Academies of Emergency Dispatch, and the homepage lists current versions of MPDS, FPDS, PPDS and ECNS.

Emergency Communications Centers are provided the technology, tools and training, within a single system. Other products include QPR, which supports existing quality assurance work with QA staff and solutions. A training product provides on-demand practice for Emergency Dispatchers using call simulations.

The Priority Dispatch System is used in 60 countries and fields over 100 million calls a year. The company says it invented structured Emergency Dispatch in 1978 and has been perfecting it since. The homepage puts ProQA in 160 of the 200 largest cities in the United States.

quote.text: The Priority Dispatch System is used in 60 countries around the world to confidently field over 100 million calls a year.
